text:
maria: Quick sync — need final tradeoffs for the visibility launch. Customer asks are mostly: per-route cost breakdown, trace sampling hooks, and error-slice analytics. We can realistically ship two of three for GA.
jasper: From infra POV, trace hooks are the heaviest lift (about 2 full sprints: ingestion + storage changes). Per-route cost is mostly UI + tagging, smaller infra impact. Error analytics needs backend event sampling and a new index.
kevin: Sales/Support note: one enterprise lead is explicitly asking for per-route cost + audit logs before they sign. If we drop cost, we risk losing that deal.
sophie: Product suggestion: GA minimal = dashboards (templates + per-route cost). Stretch goal = opt-in trace hooks in beta. Defer full error-slice analytics to 1.1.
maria: Can we write concrete launch acceptance criteria? Thinking: (1) per-route cost visible in dashboard for top 10 routes, accuracy within 10% against billing run, (2) trace hooks available as opt-in feature flags with docs, (3) no observable latency degradation >5% on p95.
jasper: Perf numbers: current telemetry pipeline handles +15% token volume headroom. Trace hooks add tail latency risk if sampling sync is used — prefer async sampling with small buffer. We'll add load-test tasks: "trace-hook-loadtest" and "cost-aggregation-smoke".
olivia: UX constraints: need 3 dashboard templates (default, cost-focused, errors-focused) and an error drilldown flow (stack + traces linked). If we only do basic per-route cost, we can ship templates + drilldown placeholders and iterate post-GA.
kevin: Can we ship per-route cost with limited tags (service, route, customer_id)? Customers want audit logs too — legal/security OK with pseudonymized customer_id for GA?
sophie: Security flagged audit retention and KMS integration for private deployments. We'll add an acceptance task: "audit-logs + KMS verified in staging".
jenkins-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature/visibility-gamma -> canary at 1764310200. Tests: telemetry-smoke, cost-regression-suite.
maria: Decision for this thread: GA scope = dashboards (templates + per-route cost for top routes) + audit logs enabled for enterprise with pseudonymized IDs; trace hooks shipped as opt-in beta behind FF; full error analytics deferred to 1.1. Owners assigned: jasper (infra), olivia (UX), sophie (product eng).
sophie: I'll draft the acceptance checklist and post in the roadmap doc. Checklist highlights: list of test prompts, cost accuracy target, SLO verification, audit log retention test, FF for trace hooks.
kevin: I'll loop in sales and the enterprise lead — note they want billing alignment and a sign-off gate for audit. tagging sample: `tags: [service, route, enterprise_billing]`.
maria: Thanks all — I'll update the roadmap and add a short note to release planning. Follow-up sync tomorrow 10am. :thumbsup:
